title: DOE-03: GAO-18-477 Recommendation 2 implementation artifact and milestone record
summary: GAO-18-477 Recommendation 2 remains Open. Its normalized follow-through state is No conforming artifact reported; the record separates the named artifact, visibility, milestone, GAO review state, and remaining gap.
key_findings: Current GAO status: Open; status period: February 2026.
Normalized implementation stage: No conforming artifact reported.

Response artifact: Strategic Petroleum Reserve Long-Term Strategic Review. DOE said it would conduct the review on a five-year cycle, but GAO reported in February 2026 that the review was not finalized.
Artifact availability: No completed review linked on the GAO page.
Named milestone: Fiscal year 2021; milestone state: Elapsed without conforming artifact.
GAO review state: No completed artifact reported.
Remaining gap: A finalized periodic review with timely cost-and-benefit information for Congress.

Continuation rule: Recheck when DOE finalizes a periodic review or GAO changes the recommendation status. Preserve DOE-03 as the parent crosswalk; do not translate an artifact, promise, submission, or GAO review into implementation, closure, or operating outcome.
why_it_matters: Recommendation-specific follow-through makes it possible to distinguish a promise, an available artifact, a submission, GAO review, partial addressing, implementation, closure, and later operating outcomes.
ftfn_relevance: Preserves DOE-03 as the parent crosswalk.
Records public artifact availability without treating availability as sufficiency or implementation.
Keeps named dates as monitors that do not pause the active content queue.
evidence_limits: A promised milestone is a monitor, not implementation evidence.
An agency artifact or submission is not implementation unless its scope satisfies the recommendation and the official record supports that conclusion.
Open – Partially Addressed is an official recommendation status, not the Phase 56F Partially Closed entity evidence state.
Recommendation closure would not by itself establish operating performance, readiness, safety, savings, value, or causation.
